topic: A neighbor asks to use part of the yard for a garden
text: Sure, I'd be glad to have you use part of my yard for a garden! It’s such a lovely idea, and I can’t wait to see what you grow. The spot by the fence gets great sunlight, perfect for anything you want to plant. Maybe we could even plan a little corner for herbs; I’d love to have some fresh basil and mint around. Let’s pick a day to get started and we can set everything up. I’m looking forward to it!
